summary: Flagstar Bank filed an 8-K announcing planned leadership updates on May 18, 2026. CEO Joseph M. Otting will relinquish the President role while continuing as Executive Chairman and CEO. Richard Raffetto and Lee Smith, both Senior Executive Vice Presidents, were appointed Co-Presidents and Co-COOs, with Raffetto becoming Chief Banking Officer and Smith remaining CFO. Bao Nguyen was elevated to Chief Legal Officer. These changes are part of the bank's succession planning and strategic realignment. Terms include no purchase price or premium. Watch for further organizational shifts as the bank executes its long-term strategy.
